inputs.text: Organisers say an estimated 8 million people joined “No Kings” protests at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, opposing President Donald Trump’s leadership. That’s a striking show of people asserting their right to challenge concentrated political power—and the scale suggests these concerns reach far beyond a single community. Authorities have not provided an official count, so the figure remains the organisers’ estimate; they say turnout exceeded the October demonstrations by about one million participants and 600 events.
